definitions.explanation: The area where the upper and lower eyelids meet near the nose. Often referenced in emotional contexts.

examples.japanese: {目頭|めがしら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{熱|あつ}く→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My eyes welled up with tears.
examples.notes: Literally 'the inner corners of my eyes got hot.' A common expression for being moved to tears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感動|かんどう}して→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧{目頭|めがしら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}さえた→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: I was so moved that I pressed the corners of my eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{目頭|めがしら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{熱|あつ}く→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Seeing my child at the graduation ceremony, I couldn't help but tear up.

notes:
USAGE: Most commonly appears in the set expression {目頭|めがしら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{熱|あつ}く→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to have tears well up, to be moved to tears). This is a more restrained, literary way of expressing being moved than simply saying ⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目頭|めがしら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{熱|あつ}く→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to tear up, to be moved to tears
- {目頭|めがしら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}さえる→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧: to press the inner corners of one's eyes (to hold back tears)

ANATOMY: Contrasts with ⟦{目尻|めじり}→目尻：21905_mejiri⟧ (outer corner of the eye).
